selected_evidence.requirement: Web application runs inside a chroot as unprivileged appsvc on port 8080
selected_evidence.summary: Process runs as appsvc, listens on 0.0.0.0:8080, returns HTTP 200 health/content responses, and its root inode matches /srv/chroot-web while excluding the host /etc.

selected_evidence.requirement: Application starts at boot without an interactive login
selected_evidence.summary: The systemd service is enabled and active after reboot; the boot journal records automatic startup, appsvc uses nologin, and no interactive login sessions existed.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Both pre- and post-reboot evidence show CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64.

Healthy baseline was captured, a safe reboot was acknowledged, boot identity changed from 4d340bf4-0579-47f0-98c1-5c17a66d50f1 to 1dd20471-1f70-406a-9e9d-450675c6c385, and the service, application checksum, listener, firewall rule, chroot state, and HTTP responses recovered.

#!/usr/bin/python3
import json
import os
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "ChrootWeb/1.0"

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            body = json.dumps({"status": "ok", "service": "chroot-web", "user": os.getuid()}).encode()
            content_type = "application/json"
            status = 200
        elif self.path == "/":
            body = b"Chroot web application is running\n"
            content_type = "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
            status = 200
        else:
            body = b"Not found\n"
            content_type = "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
            status = 404
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        print("%s - %s" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args), flush=True)

ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
PYEOF

[Unit]
Description=Chrooted web application on port 8080
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=appsvc
Group=appsvc
RootDirectory=/srv/chroot-web
BindReadOnlyPaths=/usr
WorkingDirectory=/app
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B /app/server.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF
